scope: Project composition obligations; not component implementation guarantees or passing evidence.

requirements.statement: Opening push filters reduces the adjacent results region width on a wide container; closing restores it.
requirements.verification: Compare results bounding rectangles before, during and after opening.

requirements.statement: Push filters create no backdrop, modal dialog, inert results or focus trap. Results remain interactive.
requirements.verification: Open filters, interact with results, and inspect inert/modal/backdrop state.

requirements.statement: At narrow widths filter controls stack before results, with page overflow contained.
requirements.verification: Check source order, bounding rectangles and page scroll width at narrow container size.

requirements.statement: The host accepts density changes and updates the controlled value. All supported choices produce distinct row heights.
requirements.verification: Select each density, assert pressed state and measure actual rendered rows.

requirements.statement: Comparable collection pages use the same selected search measure and expand to available width on narrow layouts.
requirements.verification: Compare computed widths on sibling collection pages at equal container sizes.

requirements.statement: One shared PageHeader owns the page title, description and actions; the selected navigation variant is reused.
requirements.verification: Inspect shared imports and compare the rendered header hierarchy across project pages.

requirements.statement: Theme, panel visibility and responsive changes preserve host query, filters, selection and drafts.
requirements.verification: Change presentation and available width with nonempty state, then compare the state.
